_note: Golden event catalogue (PHASE_01 / 01.6). Generated from platform_core/engine/events.py and reviewed: every outbox event type of PHASE_00 + PHASE_01 (+ PHASE_02 / 02.2: identity.serial.allocated; + PHASE_02 / 02.3: the identity.* / commercial.* engine events; + 02.4: planning rejection, external references) with producer module, aggregate type, sensitivity (S1: ids, status codes, counts only), current and accepted schema versions and the JSON Schema of each payload version. A change of this file is a contract change (new version + reviewed commit). Human-readable copy: docs/integration/EVENT_CATALOGUE.md.

commercial.order.changed.description: approved change request applied: new order version (DEC-059)

commercial.order.confirmed.description: order confirmed; every line got its serial in the same transaction (DEC-006 L-A, DEC-057)

identity.code_rule.golden_cases_added.description: code rule revision golden cases added (DEC-005)

identity.customer_brand.created.description: brand of a customer created (DEC-058 B-A)

identity.customer_brand.updated.description: brand of a customer updated (DEC-058 B-A)

identity.external_ref.created.description: external reference created (DEC-058; the value is not in the payload)

identity.external_ref.ended.description: external reference ended (DEC-058; the value is not in the payload)

identity.product.created.description: product created; number = max of type + 1, or buckle + width for belts (DEC-005)

identity.product_code.erp_matched.description: reserved code seen in the Rahkaran import -> ACTIVE / ERP_MATCHED (DEC-005 B1)

identity.product_code.reserved.description: 14-digit code issued RESERVED / ERP_PENDING under the ACTIVE rule (DEC-005 B1)

identity.serial.allocated.description: serial allocated at order confirm with its snapshot v1 (gapless counter, DEC-006)

identity.serial.cancelled.description: serial cancelled with its line; the number is never re-used (DEC-059)

identity.serial.snapshot_added.description: next serial snapshot written by an applied change request (DEC-059)

identity.style.created.description: style created; number = count of the product and category + 1 (DEC-005)

platform.document.object.purged.description: bytes of a rejected upload purged (DEC-053); hash kept

platform.identity.session.stepped_up.description: MFA step-up recorded on the session

platform.identity.user.mfa_reset.description: admin MFA reset (factors revoked, sessions ended)

platform.integration.compensation_record.description: compensation recorded for a dead-lettered event

platform.org.unit.moved.description: org unit moved in the tree
